description: WRITE tool — write a fresh AI reply draft for a review using the app's instructions (and an optional hint), with English translations. Counts against the monthly AI-draft allowance, then 1 credit per draft. Never posts. Tip: agents can skip this and write the reply themselves with sonar_update_review_reply (not metered). Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

hint.description: One-off direction for this draft, e.g. "mention the fix in 2.1".

review_id.description: Sonar review id (the `id` of an item from sonar_review_inbox — not Apple's review id).

name: sonar_draft_review_reply
title: Draft Review Reply (AI)
